summary: Red-phase tests-writing run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). GeneratedClientTests.swift (9 tests) pins the full generated-client surface (module OpenAPIGenerated; operationIds getTestSheetManifest/listRecentTestSheets/createCapture/uploadMeasurements/uploadJudgments/getRankedResults) against local URLProtocol stubs built from the real upstream spec and controllers. It intentionally fails to build ('no such module OpenAPIGenerated') until the implementation run vendors the spec; that is the red-phase missing-behavior signal. Existing APIClientTests fixtures were corrected from 204 to the real 200+JSON-receipt responses and stay green. Contract deltas and endpoint gaps between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (viamin/color_matching#113) are recorded in docs/generated-openapi-client-plan.md for the PR description. No Swift toolchain exists in this container (and the SwiftUI executable target cannot build on Linux), so swift test could not be executed here; the tests run in macOS CI per .github/workflows/ci.yml.
